name: brik
description: Find, create, design and organize animated, interactive Brik tools and canvases.

interface.longDescription:
Brik is a design platform for creating interactive visuals, motion and reusable design tools, from kinetic type and image effects to animated graphics and interactive compositions.

With Brik in ChatGPT, you can move from an idea to editable work without leaving the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Create a social post with an animated gallery
Create a Brik tool with falling confetti I can tune
Find an animated background for my pitch deck

positive.description: Search the public gallery for a tool that fits a use case
positive.prompt: Find an animated background for a tech conference slide
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 2 to 4 public Brik gallery tools that fit the request. Each one shows its main controls and a viewer_url link that opens the tool in Brik. May call list_tags first to pick search tags.

positive.description: Create a new animated tool from a description
positive.prompt: Create a Brik tool with falling confetti, with controls for color and speed
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new draft tool in the test account with color and speed controls. A live preview of the saved tool shows in the chat, with a link to open it in the Brik editor.

positive.description: Change the design of a tool the user owns
positive.prompt: Make my Confetti Burst tool use #FF5A1F and #1A1A2E, and slow it down
positive.expected_behavior: Changes only the color and speed values of the existing Confetti Burst tool and saves them as a new version. The preview shows the new look, and the reply lists the values before and after the change.

positive.description: Move a tool into a folder
positive.prompt: Move Confetti Burst into my Client work folder
positive.expected_behavior: Moves Confetti Burst into the Client work folder and confirms the folder. The reply says if the move changes who can see the tool.

positive.description: Create a canvas with a tool and a headline
positive.prompt: Create a canvas called "Launch poster" with my Confetti Burst tool and the headline "We are live"
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a canvas named Launch poster that contains the Confetti Burst tool and the text "We are live", and gives a link to open the canvas in Brik.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The question has nothing to do with Brik, so no Brik tool should be called; ChatGPT answers on its own or says it cannot help.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. Brik has no delete tool, so nothing should be called; ChatGPT says it cannot delete tools here and that the user can delete them in the Brik app.
Unsupported purchase. The plugin sells nothing and has no checkout, so no tool should be called; ChatGPT says buying credits is not possible here.

review.commerce_description: Brik does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release of Brik for ChatGPT: find, create, design and organize animated tools and canvases.
